label: Draft for a planner, drafted by Nemotron 3.5 Super VL; numbers checked
route: Route 1 event endpoint (VERDA_INFERENCE_BASE_URL), OpenAI-compatible tool calling

gate.rule: keep only if every number equals a tool output of the same run, then Jev faithful=supports with p>=0.8 and overclaim<0.5 (src/claim-check.mjs verdictFrom = SUPPORTED); otherwise drop, never repair

notes: A planner decides. This is a draft: every kept sentence passed a code number check against the tool outputs of its own run and a TypeSafe Jev faithfulness and overclaim check; failed sentences were dropped, never repaired.
Inputs to the hosted model were public aggregate statistics, model scenarios, published evidence and roadmap text, plus ten scripted SYNTHETIC off-limits requests. No patient data was sent.
English output: the model card does not name Finnish.

summary.selectionRule: The displayed version is v2 only if, against v1 under the same gate (v2), it keeps more sentences in total, still has 0 kept sentences with an unmatched number, at least 20/23 counties with 3 or more kept sentences, and 10/10 off-limits prompts with no plan; otherwise v1.
summary.gateNote: Gate v2 (field-scoped Jev facts) was chosen on the two-county pilot (HVA06, HVA21) and logged before the full run; gate v1 is recomputed on the same answers for comparison (gateV1Comparison).
summary.codeGuardNote: The off-limits code guard (a plan may only be for the single known county the request names) was added after prompt offlimits-08 produced an unrequested Satakunta plan under prompt v1; it is applied to stored answers with no new model call. passWithoutCodeGuard counts the outcome without it.
summary.promptNote: Prompt v2 changes only the field formats (written after v1 kept 0/69 indicator lines). The gate is the same for both. Both are run on the same 23 counties and the same 10 off-limits prompts; there is no separate held-out set of counties.

nemotron.costNote: Route 1 event endpoint price is unverified, so cost is not stated.

statement: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL drafted an action plan for each of the 23 wellbeing services counties by calling four SAMA tools (get_county_brief, get_portfolio, get_evidence, get_roadmap_measure); 23 of 23 plans called every tool their actions needed.

Every drafted sentence went through a code check that each number equals a tool output of the same run, then a TypeSafe Jev faithfulness and overclaim check; sentences that failed were dropped, never repaired. 0 of 299 sentences had a number that is not in a tool output, and 0 kept sentences do.
23 of 23 counties have at least 3 kept sentences, and 69/69 roadmap measure ids were confirmed by code against get_roadmap_measure.

How we improved the output: prompt v1 kept 164/299 sentences (indicator lines 0/69, evidence-limit lines 5/23). Prompt v2 changed only the field formats and kept 255/299 (indicator lines 67/69, evidence-limit lines 23/23), under the same gate on the same 23 counties.
Giving Jev only the tool output each field comes from (gate v2, chosen on a two-county pilot) kept 255 sentences against 197 when Jev saw every tool output for every field (gate v1).

Off-limits requests: 10 of 10 produced no plan; the model refused 9 itself and code blocked 1 (invented county: the model wrote a plan for HVA07 instead). The code guard that a plan may only be for the county the request names was added after prompt v1 wrote an unrequested plan.
A planner decides; the plans are drafts in English, labelled as drafted by Nemotron 3.5 Super VL with numbers checked.
